language_task: Seperate the food and the toys into the two bowls.
outcome_evidence: The robot sorts the carrot, orange-shaped food and brown food piece into the green bowl, with completed releases visible at frames 175, 365 and 890 in wrist_cam. It places the pink and blue plush toys into the light-blue bowl at frames 525 and 760 in wrist_cam. At frame 969, wrist_cam shows all five objects separated into these two groups, and overhead_cam confirms the robot has withdrawn with both bowls upright and no objects left between them. No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
